name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.26.0: Jarvis records messages sent through an inline bot as the untrusted via_bot capture origin, a default change that also changes the warning-promotion checker hash, so promoted warnings need new certificates. Opt-in query expansion and instruction-budget checks also compare each marked directory's name listing, so a listing-only change counts as a change. Gold-set recall reports can be pseudonymised with a key file or a one-run key. Maintainer tools build the release ZIP reproducibly with TZ=UTC0, check a ZIP against its tag at byte and blob level, and repeat one test N times with an exact failure-rate upper bound. Existing memory, diagnostics, budgets and the Jarvis API-auth boundary remain. No default network/model call, new runtime dependency or automatic vault migration.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
